title: The two-section product identity for canonical transported tensor boundaries
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a square-zero closed immersion with ideal $I$, $L$ an invertible module, $n\geq0$, and assume all canonical unit kernel sequences for $L^d$ are short exact, with the derived-category instances required by the canonical section boundary [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, lem-sc-module-section-boundary-exact]. Put $N=(j^*L)^n$, $F=j^*(I\otimes L^n)$, and $H=H^1(Z,-)$ [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. Use the explicit comparisons constructed in [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]: $a_e:j^*(L^{n(e+1)})\cong N^{e+1}$ and $b_e:H(F\otimes N^e)\cong H^1(X,\ker\eta_{L^{n(e+1)}})$. For an arbitrary morphism $x:\mathcal O_Z\to N^{e+1}$ define $D_e(x)=b_e^{-1}(\partial((x;a_e^{-1})(1)))$. For every $f:\mathcal O_Z\to N$, $e\geq0$, and arbitrary $x:\mathcal O_Z\to N^{e+1}$, one has $D_{e+1}(\lambda^{-1};f\otimes x)=H(\mathrm{mulTensorPowSection}(f,F,e,1))(D_e(x))+H(\rho_F^{-1};\mathrm{id}_F\otimes x)(H(\rho_F)(D_0(f^{\otimes1})))$. This is a two-section identity; no power sequence is chosen and no recurrence of powers is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses and the graded direct-sum sequence following it; Tag 0B8S, the two-section Cech cocycle product calculation.

proof.text: Sum the invertible-tensor ideal sequences in all degrees. Local line-bundle frames identify the algebra with a polynomial algebra, its quotient with the graded algebra on Z, and its kernel products with products of two ideal factors. Thus the kernel is square zero. The unit-quotient and ideal-kernel comparisons identify these sequences with the canonical unit kernel sequences.

Apply the square-zero boundary derivation theorem to arbitrary homogeneous sections f in degree n and x in degree n(e+1). Include their summands and project to degree n(e+2). The boundary of their product is f times the boundary of x plus x times the boundary of f. No power recurrence or exponent induction is used.

The explicitly constructed section comparisons identify the product with lambda inverse followed by f tensor x. The coefficient comparisons identify the two ideal actions with mulTensorPowSection f F e 1 and rho_F inverse followed by F whiskered with x. Naturality of the affine cohomology edge carries these actions to the displayed H maps. Resolution connecting maps identify with the canonical triangle connecting map defining moduleSectionBoundary. These equalities give the displayed product identity.

lean.statement:
theorem transportedTensorBoundary_product
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD}
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)))]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) (n : ℕ)
    (hshort : ∀ d : ℕ, (ShortComplex.kernelSequence
      ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
        (L.tensorPow d))).ShortExact)
    (D : TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n)
    (hD : canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons j L hI n = D) :
    let F : Z.Modules := (tensorPullback j).obj (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow n)
    let N : Z.Modules := ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n
    let H := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Z.toRingedSpace 1
    let b : ∀ e : ℕ, H.obj (show Z.Modules from F ⊗ N.tensorPow e) ≃+
        (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj
          (kernel ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
            (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))))) :=
      fun e ↦ Iso.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv (D.k e)
    let δ : ∀ e : ℕ, (𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ N.tensorPow (e + 1)) →
        (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj
          (kernel ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
            (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))))) :=
      fun (e : ℕ) (x : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ N.tensorPow (e + 1)) ↦
      RingedSpace.moduleSectionBoundary X.toRingedSpace
        (ShortComplex.kernelSequence
          ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
            (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))))) (hshort (n * (e + 1)))
        ((x ≫ (D.a e).inv).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
    ∀ (e : ℕ) (f : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ N) (x : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ N.tensorPow (e + 1))
      (cx : H.obj (show Z.Modules from F ⊗ N.tensorPow e))
      (cf : H.obj (show Z.Modules from F ⊗ N.tensorPow 0))
      (cp : H.obj (show Z.Modules from F ⊗ N.tensorPow (e + 1))),
      δ e x = b e cx → δ 0 (tensorPowSection f 1) = b 0 cf →
      δ (e + 1) ((λ_ (𝟙_ Z.Modules)).inv ≫ (f ⊗ₘ x)) = b (e + 1) cp →
      cp = H.map (mulTensorPowSection f F e 1) cx +
        H.map ((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ x) (H.map (ρ_ F).hom cf)
